texts.Route107_Text_1B926B: Yawn...\pI must have drifted off to sleep while\nI was drifting in the waves.$
texts.Route107_Text_1B92B7: Ahaha, I lost...\nI'll take a snooze, I think...$
texts.Route107_Text_1B92E7: Floating and being rocked by the\nwaves - it's like sleeping in a plush,\lcomfy bed.$

texts.Route107_Text_1B933A: The sea is like my backyard.\nLet's battle!$
texts.Route107_Text_1B9365: I lost on my home field...\nI'm in shock!$
texts.Route107_Text_1B938E: I swim the seas with a heart full of\ndreams...\pIt's a song!\nAnyways, I'm swimming some more.$

texts.Route107_Text_1B94C8: Do you know a little town called\nDEWFORD?$
texts.Route107_Text_1B94FF: A weird saying is getting really\ntrendy at DEWFORD HALL.$

texts.Route107_Text_1B9538: Did you want to battle me?\nSure, I'll go with you!$
texts.Route107_Text_1B956B: I wasn't good enough for you.$
texts.Route107_Text_1B9589: I think you're going to keep getting\nbetter. I'll go for it, too!$

texts.Route107_Text_1B95CB: LISA: We challenge you as a sister\nand brother!$
texts.Route107_Text_1B95FB: LISA: Awesome.\nYou're in a different class of tough.$
texts.Route107_Text_1B9672: LISA: If you want to battle with us,\nbring more POKéMON.$
texts.Route107_Text_1B9630: LISA: Do you have any friends who\nwould go to the beach with you?$

texts.Route107_Text_1B96AB: RAY: We always battle POKéMON, me\nand my sister.\pI always lose, but we can beat you\n2-on-2!$
texts.Route107_Text_1B9707: RAY: Wowee, you're at a higher level\nthan us!$
texts.Route107_Text_1B9788: RAY: If you want to battle us, go\nbring some more POKéMON!$
texts.Route107_Text_1B9735: RAY: My sister gave me my POKéMON.\nI raised it, and now it's my important\lpartner!$
